
  build · Build

  Usage: dm build <command> [options]

  Commands:
    docker                       # Build the container image
      <tag>                        Image tag
      --push                       Push the image after building
    release                      # Build release artifacts
      --level                      How strict to be (low|medium|high)

  Examples:
    dm build release --level high   # Strictest release build
  See also: dm deploy
